role: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Melbourne)
subject: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support EOI, Melbourne, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to a named vacancy. Your careers page invites people interested in joining Team DCE to get in touch at hr@dceng.com.au, so I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil design support work in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on civil design or delivery work is what I am looking for.

Your Richmond civil and water engineering practice is the reason I am writing. I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

• They may ask about: No Australian consulting employment yet → answer honestly from the facts; nothing beyond them was claimed.
